name: Rajasthan Post-Matric Scholarship (SJE) — SC / ST
source_organization: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Govt of Rajasthan
description: For SC and ST students who are permanent residents of Rajasthan, in Class 11 up to postgraduate and professional courses. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Your institute must be registered on the SJE portal. Amount depends on course level and hostel or home. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: Maintenance allowance, compulsory fees, books and study-tour expenses; amount depends on course and hostel/day-scholar status (per scheme summaries — confirm on the portal).
required_documents: Rajasthan domicile proof (Jan Aadhaar / domicile certificate)
